title: Procedure File: 2026/0265(COD) | Legislative Observatory | European Parliament

triage.reason: The procedure file shows the Public Procurement Act proposal (COM(2026)0590), which would amend the PPWR (Regulation 2025/40) and Waste Framework Directive, was referred to the EP IMCO committee on 11/11/2026 — a procedural step inside the 60-day window, though the underlying proposal itself dates from 09/09/2026.

draft.summary: On 11 November 2026, the committee referral was announced in the European Parliament at first reading for the Public Procurement Act (2026/0265(COD)).
draft.source_quote: | 11/11/2026 | Committee referral announced in Parliament, 1st reading |  |  |

key_dates.text: Committee referral announced in Parliament, 1st reading

draft.interpretation: Parliamentary scrutiny now moves to committee, where the procurement rules affecting recycled content and green criteria may be amended.
